official.deadline_note: Rolling scheme with no closing date: applications are submitted online throughout the year and must be uploaded at least three months before the due date of the conference.
official.application_cycle: Rolling - online applications accepted throughout the year (guidelines dated 21 August 2026)
official.status_note: The scheme page states applications can be submitted online throughout the year; there is no fixed application window.
benefits: Financial assistance up to 50 percent of the total cost of the visit for faculties; full financial assistance may be considered for faculties belonging to SC/ST categories, Persons with Benchmark Disability, and Post-Graduate scholars/Doctoral/Post-Doctoral researchers without salary protection, and for faculties from ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognized Institutes, if no financial assistance has been received from other sources
Preference to younger scholars, scholars attending a conference/seminar for the first time, and scholars from remote and backward areas

Invitations from global subject associations, reputed international organisations, universities or institutions are given preference, with due consideration to the peer review process of the conference organisers
eligibility: Faculties with regular service in public funded Universities/Deemed-to-be-Universities/Colleges, Institutes of National Importance as defined by MoE/UGC, and ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognized Institutes having a PhD degree
Post-Graduate (Regular)/PhD/PDF scholars in Social Science disciplines who are in the advanced stage of their studies/research

Independent scholars having served as Civil servants, officers from Defence services, and other professionals with a social science perspective having not less than 20 years of regular service and demonstrable research experience through publications

The application is considered only when the paper for oral presentation, after its review process, is accepted by the organizer of the Conference through a formal invite; a simple email is not considered a formal invite
Scholars invited for poster presentation, to chair a session, as conveners/rapporteurs, or to attend a workshop/training/refresher/summer/winter course are not eligible
requirements: Submission of the full length paper to be presented is mandatory and it should be either in English or Hindi
Applications should be uploaded at least three months before the due date of the Conference, followed by the hard copy of the application
The application will not be entertained or considered in any case after participation and presentation of the paper in the Conference
If the paper is co-authored, priority is given to the first author; a No Objection Certificate from the second author(s) may be attached
Application for the second time will be considered only after a gap of three years; a scholar can avail the award only twice in his/her lifetime

It is mandatory to purchase the air tickets (economy class) only from M/s Ashoka Travels and Tours (ATT), M/s Balmer Lawrie & Company Ltd (BLCL), or Indian Railways Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC)
documents: Formal invitation letter from the Conference organiser (a simple email is not accepted)
Full-length paper to be presented, in English or Hindi
Hard copy of the application with all documents, sent to: In-charge, ICG Division, Indian Council of Social Science Research, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, JNU Institutional Area, New Delhi 110067
After the visit: original boarding pass, attendance certificate, statement of expenditure and a report on participation, duly forwarded by the Supervisor/Head of the Department/Centre
After the visit: copies of air tickets, visa stamped, visa payment receipt, registration fee receipt and certificate of participation
selection_criteria: Applications are initially scrutinised by the ICSSR Secretariat
An Expert Committee reviews the research background of the applicant, the quality of the paper to be presented and the academic credential of the organising institution
Recommendations of the Expert Committee are placed before the Research Committee/Council for final approval
The Council reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason
The Indian organisation conducting seminars/conferences abroad will not be considered under the travel grant scheme
coverage: Air travel (economy class, purchased only through the three government approved travel agencies)
Maintenance costs for the period of stay abroad (not exceeding the actual days of conference plus travel dates)
Registration fee up to US$200 (scholars are encouraged to apply for exemption from the registration fee under special circumstances)
application_method: Submit the online application at https://app.icssr.org/ at least three months before the due date of the Conference
Send the hard copy of the application along with all documents to the In-charge, ICG Division, ICSSR, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, JNU Institutional Area, New Delhi 110067
Applications are screened by the ICSSR Secretariat, then reviewed by an Expert Committee, and approved by the Research Committee/Council

Expenditure is reimbursed on submission of the original boarding pass, attendance certificate, statement of expenditure and a report on the participation, duly forwarded by the Supervisor/Head of the Department/Centre
official.application_route: Apply online at https://app.icssr.org/ throughout the year (at least three months before the conference), then post the hard copy with all documents to the ICG Division, ICSSR, New Delhi.
official.citizenship_residency: Under this scheme, the financial assistance is provided to Indian scholars who have been invited to contribute and present papers at International Conferences abroad.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Broad social science disciplines (Sociology and Social Anthropology; Political Science/Public Administration; Economics; International Studies; Social Geography and Population Studies; Commerce and Management; Social Psychology; Education; Social Linguistics/Socio-Cultural Studies; Law/International Law; National Security & Strategic Studies; and other allied Social Science disciplines). Conferences organised abroad by Indian organisations are not considered.
official.research_requirement: The paper must be accepted for oral presentation by the conference organiser through a formal invitation, and the full-length paper in English or Hindi must be submitted with the application.
official.duration: Period of stay abroad not exceeding the actual days of the conference plus travel dates
official.description: The aim of this programme is to assist invited social science scholars to make substantial contributions to international conferences of significant importance, providing financial assistance to Indian scholars invited to present papers at International Conferences abroad. Assistance covers specified components of the visit, up to 50 percent of the total cost for faculties, with full assistance considered for SC/ST faculties, Persons with Benchmark Disability, and PG/doctoral/post-doctoral researchers without salary protection.
official.english_requirement: The full length paper to be presented is mandatory and should be either in English or Hindi.

verification.notes: Live-fetched the ICSSR scheme page and downloaded and extracted the full text of the official guidelines PDF dated 21-08-2026. No fixed monetary amount is published anywhere on the official pages; the value is expressed only as a share (up to 50 percent, or full cost for specified categories) of the total cost of the visit, with the registration-fee component capped at US$200. Amount fields therefore stay null.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a reimbursement travel grant, not a stipend: you fund the trip yourself and claim the sanctioned share afterwards, so bridging funds are essential. Only a formally accepted ORAL paper counts, because poster presentations, session chairs, conveners and rapporteurs are explicitly excluded, and the online application must be uploaded at least three months before the conference itself. Regular faculty can claim up to half the trip cost, so budget for the balance, while SC/ST faculty, Persons with Benchmark Disability and unsalaried PG/PhD/PDF researchers can be considered for the full cost. Air tickets must be economy class and bought only through ATT, Balmer Lawrie or IRCTC, and with only two awards per lifetime (three-year gap between them), choose your single highest-value conference invitation carefully.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Indian social science faculty and advanced PG/PhD/postdoctoral scholars with a formally accepted oral paper at a reputable overseas conference who can front the travel cost for several months.
application_readiness_checklist: Obtain the acceptance in a formal invitation letter on the organiser's letterhead - an email invitation is explicitly not accepted
Apply at app.icssr.org at least three months before the conference dates, not after the invitation arrives late
Prepare the full-length paper in English or Hindi and attach a No Objection Certificate from any co-authors
Have the hard copy of the complete application duly forwarded by your institution to the ICG Division, ICSSR, New Delhi
Book tickets only through ATT, Balmer Lawrie or IRCTC and preserve the original boarding pass, attendance certificate and receipts
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a poster presentation, session chair, convenor or rapporteur role - these are excluded outright
A simple email invitation instead of a formal invitation letter
Applications submitted after the conference has taken place, or less than three months before it
Conferences organised abroad by Indian organisations, which are excluded from the scheme
Incomplete applications, or applications not duly forwarded by the appropriate authorities
A second application inside the three-year gap, or a third award over a lifetime
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: For regular faculty, the share above 50 percent of the total visit cost; for all applicants, accommodation and expenses beyond the sanctioned maintenance for the conference plus travel days, and any registration fee above US$200.
document_audit: The full-length paper in English or Hindi must accompany the application - an abstract or a submitted-only manuscript is not enough
Reimbursement requires the original boarding pass and an attendance certificate, not photocopies
The participation report and statement of expenditure must be duly forwarded by the Supervisor/Head of the Department/Centre
Co-authored papers need No Objection Certificates from second authors to protect first-author priority
alerts: Twice-in-a-lifetime limit, with a second application considered only after a gap of three years
Tickets must be economy class and purchased only through the three government-approved agencies (ATT, BLCL, IRCTC); travel, visa and accommodation are the scholar's own responsibility
The presentation must display the ICSSR logo and its support, and the resulting paper is expected to acknowledge ICSSR in high valued journals/edited books/impactful reports
The Council may reject any application without assigning any reason, and ICSSR may ask for copies of tickets booked and visa obtained before departure
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Upload the application at app.icssr.org, post the hard copy with documents to the ICG Division, then Secretariat screening, Expert Committee review and Research Committee/Council approval, followed by post-visit reimbursement on documentation.

official.deadline_note: For academic year 2026-27 the scheme opened on 1 June 2026; defective-application and institute verification close on 15 November 2026 and DNO/SNO/MNO verification closes on 30 November 2026.
official.application_cycle: Academic year 2026-27 (fresh 2026-27 batch and renewal cases)
official.status_note: The National Scholarship Portal lists the scheme open for academic year 2026-27 with student applications open from 1 June 2026 until 31 October 2026; AICTE's June 2026 notification confirms the online portal is open for fresh and renewal applications.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The award is a lump sum towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipments, softwares etc.; no other additional grant will be payable in lieu of hostel charges and medical charges etc.
benefits: Rs. 50,000/- per annum for every year of study as a lump sum towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipments, softwares etc.
Payable for a maximum of 4 years for first year admitted students and 3 years for second year admitted students through lateral entry
After selection, the awardee is paid the scholarship through DBT mode on an annual basis
No documentary proof of expenditure needs to be attached while availing the benefit
eligibility: The girl candidate should be admitted to the first year of a Degree level course, or to the second year of the Degree course through lateral entry, in any AICTE approved institution of the respective year
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible
Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year; a valid income certificate issued by State/UT Government needs to be enclosed
The gap period between the year of passing the qualifying examination and the session of admission in the degree course should not be more than two years
requirements: The candidate fulfilling the eligibility conditions is required to apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) after initiation of the application process
The host institution where the candidate is studying is required to verify the online application
The Department of Technical Education (DTE) of the respective State/UT will verify these applications as second level of scrutiny

Renewal requires submission through NSP of the passing certificate/marksheet along with a letter from the Head of the Institution; a student failing to get promoted to the next class/level forfeits the scholarship
documents: Valid income certificate issued by State/UT Government showing family income not more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum
Marksheet of the qualifying (10+2 or equivalent) examination used for merit selection
Proof of admission to the first or second (lateral entry) year of the degree course in an AICTE-approved institution
Aadhaar-seeded bank account details for payment through DBT
selection_criteria: Selection is carried out solely on the basis of merit of the qualifying examination, i.e. percentage of marks obtained in the 10+2/equivalent examination
State/UT-wise merit list is prepared as per the number of scholarships allotted to each State/UT
Ties are broken first by higher percentage of marks in the 10th examination, then by elder age
Reservation is as per Government of India norms; vacant reserved-category seats are transferred to the General category
Provisional list of shortlisted candidates is uploaded on the AICTE web portal
coverage: Lump sum towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipments, softwares etc.
No other additional grant will be payable in lieu of hostel charges and medical charges etc.
application_method: Register and apply online on the National Scholarship Portal, selecting the 'AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)'
The host institution verifies the online application, and the State/UT Department of Technical Education conducts second-level scrutiny
The awardee is paid the scholarship through DBT mode on an annual basis after selection
official.application_route: Complete one-time registration on the National Scholarship Portal, select the AICTE Pragati (Technical Degree) scheme, upload the documents and submit before the portal deadline, then have the institution verify the application.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Degree level technical courses in AICTE-approved institutions; the separate Pragati scheme for Technical Diploma students is a different award with different duration rules.
official.duration: Every year of study: up to 4 years for first year admitted students and up to 3 years for students admitted through lateral entry
official.description: The Pragati Scholarship Scheme is implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing assistance for advancement of girls pursuing technical education, described by the Council as 'Empowering Women through Technical Education'. Girl students admitted to AICTE-approved degree institutions receive Rs. 50,000 per annum for every year of study as a lump sum towards college fee and related academic expenses.
official.program_type: Government scholarship for women in technical education

verification.notes: Live-fetched the National Scholarship Portal scheme listing (open 01-06-2026, student applications until 31-10-2026, verification windows to 15 and 30 November 2026) and downloaded and extracted the full text of the NSP-hosted official AICTE Pragati (Degree) guidelines confirming the Rs. 50,000 per annum amount, duration, coverage and selection process. The aicte.gov.in scheme and notification pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so the 19 June 2026 AICTE notification dates are corroborated against the live NSP listing rather than refetched.

applicant_utility.summary: Pragati pays a flat Rs 50,000 per year straight into an Aadhaar-seeded account for up to four years of an AICTE-approved degree, but selection is purely on your qualifying-examination marks - there is no separate AICTE application and no interview. Apply only through the National Scholarship Portal by 31 October 2026 for academic year 2026-27, then make sure your college actually verifies the application in the window that follows, because an unverified or incomplete application is discarded no matter how strong your marks are. Only two girls per family can hold the award, and if you receive any other scholarship, stipend, salary or emolument during the course, this one is discontinued and the full amount must be refunded to AICTE.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Girls who have just secured first-year or lateral-entry admission to an AICTE-approved degree such as engineering, pharmacy or management, from families earning under Rs 8 lakh a year, with strong Class 12 or equivalent marks.
application_readiness_checklist: Complete NSP one-time registration (OTR) and apply under 'AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)', not the Diploma variant
Obtain a State/UT government income certificate for the current financial year showing family income below Rs 8 lakh before the portal window closes
Keep an Aadhaar-seeded savings account in the student's own name with exactly matching name spelling so DBT credit does not fail
Confirm within days of submitting that your institution has verified the application on NSP before the 15 November 2026 cut-off
Check that the gap between passing the qualifying examination and taking admission is not more than two years
common_rejection_risks: Incomplete applications, which are summarily rejected - only verified online applications are considered for the award
Failed DBT credit because the bank account is not Aadhaar-seeded or the name does not match, with payment queries entertained only for six months after the merit list
Applying to the Technical Diploma scheme instead of the Technical Degree scheme by mistake
A third daughter in the family applying, when only two girls per family are eligible
Holding another scholarship, stipend, salary or emolument, which triggers discontinuation and a full refund to AICTE
Failing to get promoted to the next year, which forfeits the renewal
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Any tuition balance above the Rs 50,000 lump sum, hostel and medical charges (explicitly not covered), equipment or software beyond what the lump sum stretches to, and all daily living costs.
document_audit: The income certificate must be issued by a State/UT government authority for the current financial year, not a self-declaration or an older certificate

The qualifying-examination marksheet drives selection: CGPA is converted to percentage by multiplying by 9.5, grades are first converted to CGPA and averaged, and where both CGPA and total marks are given, total marks count
For renewal you must submit the passing certificate/marksheet plus a letter from the Head of the Institution on NSP - a missed renewal forfeits the next year's Rs 50,000
alerts: Academic year 2026-27 deadlines: student applications close 31 October 2026, defective-application and institute verification close 15 November 2026, and district/state nodal verification closes 30 November 2026
The award can be discontinued and clawed back in full if the student receives any other financial assistance during the course
Queries about the provisional merit list are entertained only within one month of its publication on the AICTE website

Reservation follows Government of India norms, and vacant reserved-category seats are transferred to the General category, so general-category applicants can still benefit from unfilled reserved quotas
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit on the National Scholarship Portal by 31 October 2026, the institution verifies (to 15 November 2026), the State/UT DTE nodal officer verifies next (to 30 November 2026), and payment then flows via DBT.
